title: useDebounce Hook
description:
Implement a `useDebounce<T>` hook that returns a debounced version of a value — one that only updates after the value has stopped changing for `delay` milliseconds.

**Example:**
```tsx
const debouncedSearch = useDebounce(searchTerm, 300);
```
ai_context: Tests useEffect with cleanup. The student knows useState but likely forgot the cleanup function in useEffect, or forgot to put value/delay in the dependency array.
